initial.entityTitle: Extended assisted planning consultation with a support worker
initial.description: The attendee is arranging a support worker, accessible transport, and an interpreter for a detailed planning consultation. Keep every scheduling instruction readable: the support worker must receive the same time as the attendee, the visit mode must match the chosen offer, and the detailed review cannot be shortened to fit the screen.

slots.label: Choose assisted morning
slots.detail: Monday 09:15–10:30 in the accessible meeting room beyond the main reception. Allow the attendee time to unpack printed drawings and check the induction-loop setup.

slots.label: Choose assisted afternoon
slots.detail: Monday 13:30–14:45. The alternate room is currently fully booked.

slots.label: Choose remote review
slots.detail: Friday 15:15–16:30 with the same interpreter joining remotely.
